XMLDB.COMMENT: Airpay Training Evaluations — Kirkpatrick post-training feedback

FIELD.NAME: kirkpatrick_level
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=Reaction, 2=Learning, 3=Behaviour, 4=Results

FIELD.NAME: days_after
FIELD.COMMENT: Days after trigger event before sending

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=draft, 1=active, 2=archived

FIELD.NAME: anonymous
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = responses anonymised

FIELD.NAME: timeopen
FIELD.COMMENT: P1 #17: Unix timestamp window opens. 0 = no constraint (open immediately).

FIELD.NAME: timeclose
FIELD.COMMENT: P1 #17: Unix timestamp window closes. 0 = no constraint (never closes).

FIELD.NAME: multiple_submit
FIELD.COMMENT: P1 #17: 1 = allow same user to re-submit (pulse surveys). 0 = one-and-done.

FIELD.NAME: notify_admin_on_response
FIELD.COMMENT: P1 #19: 1 = send a Moodle notification to siteadmins on every submission.

FIELD.NAME: options
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array for multichoice options

FIELD.NAME: anonymous
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = hide responder identity for this question only

FIELD.NAME: depends_on_qid
FIELD.COMMENT: P1 #30: parent question id this question depends on. NULL = always shown (default).

FIELD.NAME: depends_on_value
FIELD.COMMENT: P1 #30: only show this question when the parent's answer matches this value. For yesno parents: 'yes' or 'no'. For multichoice: one of the parent's options. For rating/nps/numeric: a stringified int. NULL with non-null depends_on_qid = 'show when parent has ANY non-empty answer'.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 if anonymous

FIELD.NAME: response_data
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON map of questionid => answer

TABLE.NAME: local_airpay_evaluation_triggers
TABLE.COMMENT: W1-5: queued evaluation triggers awaiting their fire_after delay.

FIELD.NAME: evaluationid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_airpay_evaluation.id

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The user whose action triggered this evaluation

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course/program/classroom id depending on trigger_event

FIELD.NAME: fire_after
FIELD.COMMENT: UNIX timestamp at/after which the cron task fires this

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=pending, 1=fired, 2=cancelled, 3=skipped (eval archived)

KEY.NAME: uk_eval_user_item
KEY.COMMENT: One pending trigger per (eval, user, item)

TABLE.NAME: local_airpay_evaluation_assign
TABLE.COMMENT: P1 #37: assignments — tracks WHO was meant to respond to an evaluation. Populated by the W1-5 trigger queue when invitations fire, plus future admin bulk-assign + signup auto-assign. submit_response marks status='responded'. Closes audit items #20 + #21 from parity-audit-2026-05-15/airpay_evaluation.md.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The user who was assigned to respond

FIELD.NAME: source_id
FIELD.COMMENT: Course/program/classroom id depending on trigger_event. 0 for manual assignments.

FIELD.NAME: assigned_by_userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Acting admin id for manual assignments; null for auto-assignments

FIELD.NAME: due_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional deadline (Unix ts). When set + status='assigned' + now > due_at, an admin can mark it as 'expired'.

FIELD.NAME: responded_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Set by submit_response when the user fills in the evaluation.

INDEX.NAME: idx_eval_user_src
INDEX.COMMENT: Dedupe key — one assignment per unique (eval, user, trigger source) tuple

INDEX.NAME: idx_eval_status
INDEX.COMMENT: Compliance lookup: 'show me everyone still pending on evaluation X'
